pokedexEntries.ru: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this POKéMON generates strong psychokinetic power.

pokedexEntries.sa: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG is formed. The brains of the BELDUM are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This POKéMON turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It floats midair using magnetism. Its body is so tough, even a crash with a jet plane won’t leave a scratch.

pokedexEntries.em: The claws tipping its arms pack the destructive power to tear through thick iron sheets as if they were silk. It flies at over 60 miles per hour.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It is formed by two BELDUM joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

pokedexEntries.hgss: When two BELDUM fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

pokedexEntries.bw: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

pokedexEntries.x: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

pokedexEntries.y: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

pokedexEntries.or: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. By linking its brains magnetically, this Pokémon generates strong psychokinetic power.

pokedexEntries.as: When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This Pokémon turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.

pokedexEntries.su: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.

pokedexEntries.mo: It adores magnetic minerals, so it pursues Nosepass at speeds exceeding 60 mph.

pokedexEntries.us: With its two brains, it fires powerful psychic energy to stop its prey in their tracks.

pokedexEntries.um: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.

pokedexEntries.sw: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

pokedexEntries.sh: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.
